answer_1.quote: Benchmarks. We evaluate our method on three long-context benchmarks: (1) LongBench, a realistic and diverse benchmark where we evaluate on all tasks, including QA, few-shot learning, code generation, summarization, and counting; (2) RULER, a challenging benchmark with tasks such as hay-in-the-stack, KV retrieval, variable tracking, and QA; (3) GSM-Infinite, a benchmark designed to assess mathematical reasoning under long-generation settings.
answer_1.outputs: generated text such as answers, code, summaries, and reasoning outputs
